companyDescription: UWorld is the most user-friendly test prep company on the market. They have helped millions of undergraduates, graduates, and professionals successfully prepare for high-stakes exams including USMLE, NCLEX, and more.
achievements: Received the B2B Innovation Award for defining scalable microservices, increasing system reliability by 30%.

Hardened Kubernetes deployments with network policies, RBAC and secrets management, and designed identity and access patterns for service-to-service communication.
Contributed to ML-based cognition matching algorithms for the production test platform, with attention to data integrity and tamper resistance for assessment workflows.
Awarded technical lead for the organization's most rewarding B2B platform for extraordinary contribution in the Test Preparation Interface module.

Played a crucial role in upgrading the technical stack of the product.
